basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 5 years building full-stack features, API integrations, and data pipelines for enterprise financial and security platforms. Recent work spans AI agent tooling in TypeScript and Go systems on Linux, backed by Nix-based image builds.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on enterprise financial platforms, owning feature delivery and cross-functional collaboration across international teams.
highlights: Led end-to-end delivery of production features and integrations, from API design through deployment and monitoring, and staffed on-call rotations triaging team-wide incidents.
Optimized Oracle SQL schemas and stored procedures, JPA/Hibernate mappings, and high-throughput Apache Kafka pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions.
Developed full-stack features in TypeScript, React, and Redux on the frontend and Spring Boot with Java 21 on the backend, integrating with internal systems.
Consolidated disparate historical storage into Snowflake on Azure, reducing storage costs while keeping data highly available for cross-functional teams.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Security tooling for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Built a React/Redux security dashboard for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
Resolved critical logic flaws in security risk-scoring algorithms, improving data accuracy and reducing false-positive alerts for enterprise clients.
Implemented Jest and Cypress suites, including real-time browser tests, tightening feature reliability and UI performance across staging and production.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Automation consulting for business processes across OCR, HR, and fundraising departments.
highlights: Orchestrated full-stack automation in C#/.NET and SQL for OCR, HR, and fundraising workflows.

projects.name: dossier
projects.description: Local-first CLI that runs OpenCode agent prompts to generate grounded resumes, proposals, and application answers from a career fact bank.
highlights: Designed an OpenCode agent pipeline that produces tailored resumes, proposals, and application answers from a local career fact bank
Traced every generated claim to source evidence and validated output before rendering

projects.name: SlippiOS
projects.description: Open-source Melee console image that boots a fullscreen shell and keeps games, settings, and replays on a USB stick.
highlights: Nix-packaged a bootable Linux image with A/B system updates, browser sign-in, Wi-Fi setup, and signed Secure Boot images
Wrote the Go backend and Cobra CLI that handles network ISO upload and device setup
